title: CCAT deploy in support of Hurricane Harvey relief efforts
description: About 30 Airmen from Air Education and Training Command departed Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland Kelly Field Annex Aug. 30, 2017 in support of Hurricane Harvey relief efforts.  The teams composed of Airmen from Joint Base San Antonio, Texas; Keesler Air Force Base, Miss. and Vance Air Force Base, Okla., are part of Critical Care Air Transport Teams en route to provide medical support in Houston. The CCAT is designed to support combat casualties being evacuated from the combat zone and also supports humanitarian assistance efforts during peacetime. This includes natural disasters such as Hurricane Harvey, which has affected thousands during massive flooding that began Aug. 26, 2017 in Texas.
